title: ur-ws W5 parked at its end-to-end check

reason.text: W5's end-to-end check failed twice on the plan's search for the initiative id workstation-refinement, and a second miss is a stop under standing answer 12. The pass needs one ruling on that search before it can run the check again and close.

calls.question: May an end-to-end outline name the initiative id workstation-refinement?

options.label: Narrow the search to /var/home and text copied from the initiative's record
options.consequence: The executor relaunches, runs the check once more with the same prompt, and an outline may name the id as a backlog tag.

options.label: Keep the search and tell the subagent to name no initiative
options.consequence: The prompt grows by one sentence the plan does not allow today, and the executor reruns the check.

options.label: Keep both as written and run the check again
options.consequence: A third outline will probably hold the string too, since the tag sits on two of the three sample items, and the pass parks again.

evidence.text: Backlog items #69 and #70, the acceptance item's sample work, each carry the tag #initiative:workstation-refinement in BACKLOG.md, a file already public in the repo.
Two fresh Sonnet outlines held the string on three lines and on two. Neither held /var/home, and nothing in them came from the initiative's record.
The rule it reads against says to copy nothing from the record into a repo file, a plan, a PR, or a packet.

steps.text: Record your ruling under Rulings in the W5 plan, commit it on ur-w5, and push.
Relaunch the W5 executor from its prompt. It runs the end-to-end check, the full gate, and the closing review, and marks the PR ready.
Hold W5, W1, W2, and W4 for the round's close packet. W3 launches after W5 ends.

notChecked.text: Neither outline was read line by line against the ten contents the acceptance item asks for, since the search failed first.
The full gate and the closing review have not run on W5.

reviews.text: No whole-branch review has run on W5. The fast lane was green after tasks T1 and T2.
